findings.message: The 'Next step' label sits right beside the lowest-point dot and its 'Lowest point' label, so it is easy to confuse which label names what.
The bowl's far corners touch the top edge of the default view. A little more headroom would frame it better.
Not sampled: learning rate 0.01, batch 'All 256 examples (no noise)', and 'New run, keep old path' with the kept path. The comparison the learning goal relies on is unverified.

'Next step' sits below and away from its short purple arrow with no visible leader line. 'Full-batch step' is wrapped onto two lines and pulled far left. Both arrows are partly buried under the thick orange path near the ball.

At learning rate 2 the noisy first step already leaves the drawn bowl, so the run stops after one step. The learner sees one straight jump to the rim rather than swings that keep growing. This is correct and disclosed, but it shows divergence weakly.
The 'Full-batch step' label is not visible from this angle, though its dark arrow is drawn.
